verdict.rationale: CSC's Compliance Calendar in CSCNavigator automatically creates events for annual reports and related filing obligations and proactively emails alerts to unlimited users. A report also lists upcoming filings 45 days in advance with each entity's good-standing status, across a multi-jurisdiction dashboard. Missing for 10: explicit franchise-tax deadline alerts (only 'related filing obligations' is stated), documentation that alerts are tied to the states where CSC is registered agent rather than a separate annual-report service, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, I get alerts ahead of each state's annual report and franchise tax deadlines for every state where the provider is my agent

citations.quote: The Compliance Calendar® automatically creates calendar events for annual reports and related filing obligations, and proactively sends email alerts
You receive a report that outlines upcoming filings 45 days in advance, along with the good standing status of each entity that has a filing due in this window
The CSC good standing calendar can automatically send email reminders to unlimited users.
